title: StateCraft: Augmenting Video World Models with Abstract-State Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19795v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video world models aim to simulate complex environments with realistic appearance and dynamics. Maintaining consistency over long interactions requires tracking past actions and understanding how those actions affect the environment. Video world models can only generate partial observations of the entire world at a time. Remembering past observations alone may not be sufficient in every scenario, as they may no longer reflect the world after a sequence of actions. We introduce a paradigm that decouples a persistent, updatable abstract state from the visual state. The abstract state keeps track of the entities' changes as the world evolves, and is used to condition the visual state, which represents the current view. We propose StateCraft, a novel architecture that pairs a language model with a video diffusion model to evolve the dynamic world. translated_title: StateCraft：通过抽象状态推理增强视频世界模型
translated_abstract: 视频世界模型旨在以逼真的外观和动态效果模拟复杂环境。要在长时间交互中保持一致性，需要追踪过去的动作并理解这些动作如何影响环境。视频世界模型一次只能生成整个世界的部分观察结果。仅记住过去的观察在许多场景中并不充分，因为经过一系列动作后，这些观察可能已不再反映世界的真实状态。我们引入了一种新范式，将持久、可更新的抽象状态与视觉状态解耦。抽象状态随世界演进而追踪实体的变化，并被用来作为视觉状态（即当前视图）的条件。我们提出了StateCraft，这是一种将语言模型与视频扩散模型相结合以演化动态世界的新型架构。我们在生成式接口上评估了我们的方法，这带来了重大挑战，因为
tldr: StateCraft提出将持久可更新的抽象状态与视觉状态解耦的新范式，通过语言模型追踪世界演化中的实体变化并以此条件化视频扩散模型，从而显著提升视频世界模型在长期交互中的状态一致性与推理能力。
en_tdlr: StateCraft introduces a paradigm that decouples a persistent, updatable abstract state from the visual state, pairing a language model with a video diffusion model to track entity changes as the world evolves, thereby enhancing long-horizon consistency and reasoning in video world models.
